name: Siskiyou Adult Education Pathways Consortium
description: Offers high school diploma, GED prep, ESL/citizenship classes, and career technical training through consortium of adult schools and College of the Siskiyous.

description: Community college offering credit and noncredit courses, vocational training (EMS, nursing, fire academy), transfer programs, and continuing education.
address: 800 College Avenue, Weed, CA 96094 and 2001 Campus Dr., Yreka, CA 96097

name: Siskiyou County Behavioral Health Services – North Office
description: Mental health and substance use outpatient services, crisis intervention, assessments, case management. Siskiyou County Behavioral Health Services – South Office

name: Siskiyou County Public Health Department
description: WIC, immunizations, communicable disease control, maternal/child health, health education, emergency preparedness. Recognized for PHAB Pathways excellence.

name: Siskiyou County Housing & Homeless Services (via HHSA)
description: Referrals to emergency housing, rent and utility assistance, and homelessness prevention.

name: Siskiyou County Health & Human Services Agency (HHSA)
description: Medi-Cal, CalFresh, CalWORKs, General Assistance, CPS/APS, IHSS, and veteran services.

name: Siskiyou Domestic Violence & Crisis Center
description: Crisis support, advocacy, and shelter for domestic violence survivors.

name: Siskiyou County Behavioral Health – Substance Use Services

address: 2060 Campus Drive, Yreka, CA 96097 and 1107 Ream Avenue, Mt. Shasta, CA 96067

name: Siskiyou Community Food Bank

name: Siskiyou Food Assistance Pantry (Weed)
description: Drive-thru food distribution every Wednesday (11 AM–3 PM), proof of ID and residence required.
